question: Why may something unspeakable still be spoken to those whose refuge is compassion?
premises: Even so it must be spoken by the devotee.
Those addressed are compassionate and take refuge in compassion.
inference: Compassion justifies speaking what would otherwise remain unspeakable.
plain_english: Even if it is unspeakable, still it must be spoken by me, out of compassion, to those whose refuge is compassion.
